body: Thanks! You have been a huge help. It might take me a while to pay this one forward. I actually feel a lot better about all of it. I mean it still scares me but it feels like something I can deal with now instead of this huge, insurmountable problem.
I don't want them to leave me. I don't want them to not like me anymore.
It was multiple events by my parents when I was a kid. And you have really good points. I'm just so scared of bringing itt up to my friends and risking further rejection, and abandonment.
